_doc: claude/reality2 (rule garage-has-drive, gates census gateLostToGarage): the door paths next to a garage drive with no gate leaf within 8 m that are allowed: fronts that had no gate on claude/foundation either. Any other place is a lost gate (a builder bug). Frozen: built from the foundation-vs-branch gates census diff (tools/audit/census/gates.mjs --list on claude/foundation 82d295b3 data/gardens vs claude/reality2 at 03d2e7a8, then the door-rule rebuild of 2026-11-27); a later round rebuilds it the same way, never by hand.
